Subject: Request: HealthBridge initiative bundle exception - need VP/CFO signoff

Marissa / Naomi,

Summary: HealthBridge (prospect -> pilot/POC imminent) is asking for a single-year "initiative" bundle that combines Private deployment + guaranteed burst capacity + onboarding services. Their procurement pushed hard on price; the commercial ask would reduce list ACV by ~42% for year 1. Deal details below.

Why this matters: HealthBridge is a strategic inbound pilot for the clinical vertical (large network of hospitals). If we win the pilot and show operational parity for on-prem telemetry, adoption could lead to multi-year Dedicated commitments. But the initial ask is outside normal discount guardrails.

Proposed exception (recommended by me, Hannah):
- 35% list discount months 0-6, step down to 20% months 7-12
- Minimum committed spend: $120,000 ACV (billed quarterly)
- One-time onboarding credit capped at $40,000 (applied to month 1)
- Limited to a 12-month term; no renewals auto-approved without finance re-review
- Require telemetry + SLA addendum + mutual action plan signed before go-live

Impact: Estimated year-1 revenue recognition (cash) aligned to $120k ARR but gross margin compression of ~18 percentage points in year 1 given support/onboarding and burst cost assumptions. See attached P&L snapshot and pricing sheet for line-item math.

Attachments: healthbridge_pricing_v2.xlsx, MAP_HealthBridge.docx, hb_pnl_snapshot_q3_2028.pdf

Asking: VP/CFO signoff to approve this deviation from standard commercial guardrails so we can finalize DocuSign and close the pilot LOI this week. If approved, Jordan can route to Legal for the retention and SLA clauses.

Thanks,
Hannah

> Thanks for the concise write-up, Hannah. A few items I need before I can greenlight this: 
> 1) Naomi - can you quantify the gross margin impact...

Quick answers inline and attaching sensitivity table:
- Naomi: attached P&L snapshot (hb_pnl_snapshot_q3_2028.pdf) and a 3-scenario sensitivity in the pricing workbook. Base-case uses 12% churn for pilot-year and 25% uplift probability to Dedicated in year 2.
- Private requirement: HealthBridge's security team insists on VPC/private deployment due to PHI ingest and hospital network segmentation. They will not consider Dedicated unless we offer an isolated VPC with HSM key controls; that's effectively Private for our product definitions.
- Cancellation / clawback: Suggested contract language: 30-day notice, pro-rated billing for usage beyond committed minimum, and a retrospective clawback of onboarding credits if they terminate before month 6 (pro-rate credits by month). Legal will need to draft precise language, but we can include that as a condition of approval.

Key commercial ask: given the regulatory constraint, we should accept a slightly larger upfront discount in exchange for a hard commit and strict credit clawbacks. Sensitivity sheet shows break-even on contribution margin at ~28% discount on year 1 assuming 25% chance to convert to Dedicated year 2.

I've attached: healthbridge_pricing_v2.xlsx (with sensitivity tab), MAP_HealthBridge.docx, hb_pnl_snapshot_q3_2028.pdf

If Finance signs off on deferred recognition, I'm comfortable asking Marissa/Jordan for executive signoff.

Thanks,
Hannah
